info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Offer Management API
info.description: The Customer Offer Management API enables businesses to create and manage customer-specific offers within the banking and sales domain. This endpoint facilitates the submission of new offers tailored to individual customer needs, enhancing customer engagement and satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and sales departments looking to personalize their offerings and improve customer retention. By efficiently handling offer submissions, businesses can drive sales and streamline their customer relationship management processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new offer for a customer. You will need to provide the relevant details in the request body to successfully create the offer. Make sure to include all necessary fields to ensure the offer is processed correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new customer offer in the sales system. It should contain all necessary information about the offer, including customer details and terms of the offer.
